name: Slides
description: The first clip shrinks away toward an edge, a corner or the center, or the second clip grows in from there. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: position
params.description: Where the picture shrinks to or grows from: 0 top, 1 right, 2 bottom, 3 left, 4 top right, 5 bottom right, 6 bottom left, 7 top left, 8 center

params.name: slide_in
params.description: Grow the second clip in instead of shrinking the first out
